messages:
Priya Rao: Quick weekly check-in for Greenline — pulsing some risk signals on errors/spend. TL;DR: overall usage -11% WoW, spike in 5xx/timeouts yesterday during 12:30-13:10 PDT. Need eng triage + a customer-facing note. :warning:
Ethan Chen: copying logs snapshot here. p95 latency jumped from 420ms -> 1.2s around 12:35. 5xx rate peaked at 5.6% (normal ~0.4%). timeouts ~3.2%, rate-limits ~1.1%.
Samir Gupta: can you paste the top endpoints?
Priya Rao: sure — top failing endpoints by count: 1) `POST /v1/generate` (60% of 5xx), 2) `POST /v1/embeddings` (18%), 3) `POST /v1/session/activate` (9%), others misc (13%).
Maya Li: got it. Any pattern on payload size or model variant?
Ethan Chen: looks correlated with long-context runs — sequences > 4k tokens. Kernel OOM-ish failures then cascade into 502s. Example log: ```2026-03-19T19:35:02Z ERROR serve: model-infer failed: CUDA OOM during forward; request_id=abc123```. 
Priya Rao: customer noted they bumped batch size and enabled longer contexts on Tuesday after a prod push. We flagged it in onboarding notes but didn't block changes.
Samir Gupta: immediate asks: (1) can eng add a temporary guard that rejects >4k token runs for this account (or route to lower-capacity model) and return 4xx? (2) add an autoscale or fallback to a smaller model during OOMs?
Ethan Chen: I can push a soft-limit in the routing layer to reject >4k with 400 + clear error and a suggestion to retry with a shorter context. For fallback, need a canary config to route to `redwood-model-small-v1` when memory pressure >85%.
Priya Rao: customer impact: they reported 8 failed jobs yesterday, 3 retry attempts each, billed for retries ~ $42 spike. They're asking for a mitigation and a short RCA for renewal team.
Maya Li: I'll draft a short customer note summarizing mitigation and next steps. ETA 2 hours.
Samir Gupta: tagging OpsBot to create an internal incident and track RCA tasks.
OpsBot: Incident created: INC-20260319-4382 — "Greenline 5xx/timeouts spike (long-context OOM)". Assigned to: Ethan Chen, Samir Gupta. Priority: P2.
Ethan Chen: working on soft-limit PR now, will post link when ready. Also scheduling a short config change to add fallback routing rule — low-risk, can ship today.
Priya Rao: thanks team. Next steps: (1) Ethan deploy soft-limit + fallback (2) Maya send customer note + rollback/mitigation steps (3) Samir own RCA doc and cost impact calc. I'll follow up in tomorrow's check-in. :thumbsup:
